purpose: Engineering acceptance map for functional equivalence; this file does not activate features or certify provider coverage.

constraints.theme: Preserve the current deployed SignalForge theme.
constraints.identity: Keep SignalForge branding and independent implementation.
constraints.evidence: Separate visible screenshot controls, official product claims, and verified SignalForge behavior.
constraints.providers: Hosted integrations need authorized server-side provider access; a connector in this chat is not a hosted integration.
constraints.unknowns: Waldo private workflow configuration, execution results, billing behavior, and team permissions have not been exercised live. This is not an exhaustive parity certification.

features.current: Editable owner-scoped brand/topic profiles with revision-checked saves, safe website links, search and a saved brand workspace. The workspace counts all explicitly associated reports, projects, active/archived files, saved workflows and conversations, and previews latest 10 reports/projects/active files. It opens the full brand-filtered report library, files and workflows, starts a brand-prefilled chat or research brief, and exposes the automatic weekly India rule/history. Edits atomically refresh an existing automatic rule while preserving pause/schedule/history. Existing research and chat/workflow/pitch snapshots remain unchanged; new chats capture the current website and revision. A persistent owner-scoped Brand view now filters associated workspace lists and supplies defaults for new work. D1 preferences survive reload/device changes; explicit URL scope/legacy links override the default. Identity-based associations keep same-name brands separate and unassociated legacy items in All brands. Open drafts, saved inputs and direct record views retain context; deleting a brand clears the selection. Prior context is archived on successful edits; paginated history and CAS-checked restore create a new revision without rewriting saved research.
features.gap: Pre-activation context history is unavailable. Brand view is a filter/default; workspace membership controls shared access.
acceptance: Switching brands scopes all related content consistently.
Reloading preserves the selection and unauthorized users cannot read another owner's records.

features.current: Brand/project-scoped independent chat with immutable brand and hypothetical persona snapshots, per-answer Strategy/Research agent choice, supported context files, cited background answers and bounded recent-turn memory. Saved conversations support search, favorites, older-chat pagination, rename/delete confirmation, retry/cancel, older-message pagination beyond 100 turns, source-aware copying and full Markdown export. Creation and send retries preserve request identity. Team workspaces share chats with My/All creator filters. Browser-supported dictation fills reviewable text without auto-send and stops on navigation.
features.gap: Specialist datasets remain unavailable. Browser speech support/privacy varies; My is a creator filter, not private team visibility.
acceptance: Create, reopen and search a brand-scoped conversation with saved context.
My/All views respect membership and visibility permissions, including paginated older conversations.

features.current: Nine catalog cards with filters/favorites, five runnable open-web presets and four explicitly unavailable provider-dependent presets. Editable templates retain owned brand/project/file defaults, briefs, audience, competitors and time windows; support customization, duplication and step reordering. Runs snapshot inputs/steps, preserve report attempts, hand prior findings/sources forward, export combined output and rerun the saved configuration. Review mode or continuous progression with signed-webhook background execution, including when the page is closed; errors and partial results pause. Idempotent creation and expected-step/report guards protect against delayed duplicate launches. Full keyset-paginated run history reaches older work beyond the latest-100 preview.
features.gap: Specialist social/ad presets require provider access; richer private Waldo behavior remains unverified.
acceptance: A workflow accepts saved inputs, executes defined steps, persists progress and exposes retryable failures.
Users can create, save, reopen, search and favorite workflows; a template button alone does not satisfy execution.

features.current: Owner-scoped project create/edit/search/remove, optional brand association, linked reports and workflow runs. Removing a project retains reports and run history. Project/brand-associated context files are organized through the Files library; deleting a project detaches files without deleting them. Team workspaces share projects. Full library links and paginated workflow history reach older work; creation-date and explicitly linked enabled-monitor filters are available.
features.gap: Per-project access overrides and recurring multi-step project execution remain unimplemented/unverified reference behavior. Membership is workspace-wide.
acceptance: Create and reopen a project containing linked research and files.
Search and reference filters return matching records; visibility is enforced server-side.

features.current: Organized Files library: PDF text (up to 50 pages), DOCX main-body text, UTF-8 TXT/CSV/Markdown. Files up to 5 MB and 100,000 extracted characters; previews, original downloads, project/brand association, rename, archive/restore. Up to three files share a 30,000-character context budget with explicit omissions and page/paragraph/line attribution. Owner checks and legacy text uploads are preserved. PPTX preserves declared slide order with slide references. XLSX extracts visible sheet/cell text and saved formula values without recalculation. DOCX includes separately attributed headers, footers, footnotes, endnotes and comments under bounded limits.
features.gap: OCR/scanned PDFs and image/chart interpretation remain unavailable. Spreadsheet dates/number formats/formulas are not evaluated. Permanent retention cleanup is not added.
acceptance: Each supported format is parsed with traceable file/page references; unsupported or unreadable inputs show explicit errors.
Project/brand file selection preserves ownership and existing text uploads.

features.current: Saved sourced reports with full-account server-side title/subject/question search and combined favorites, exact labels, project/brand/type/status/date filters. Metadata-only keyset pagination reaches reports beyond the latest-100 workspace preview, including stable tied timestamps. Grid/list views share the same query, with filter/view state retained in the URL across opening reports and reloading. Full account report/completed counts are distinct from bounded overview previews. Existing organization, Markdown export, printing and revocable links are preserved. Completed and partial reports with saved text export editable DOCX including status, question, market, date, body, numbered clickable citations and a full source appendix. Existing Markdown and Print/PDF remain available. Team membership shares the existing library. Saved reports export full editable PowerPoint text slides with sources; developer keys can read the full metadata library page.
features.gap: Per-author requester filters and per-record permissions remain pending. Legacy developer list arrays retain compatibility bounds.
acceptance: Favorites and labels persist; combined filters produce correct accessible results.
Grid/list views open the same report and preserve filter state.

features.current: Background OpenAI web research, citation extraction, saved reports and follow-up web research. Signed OpenAI webhooks persist terminal states without opening detail pages and advance eligible background workflows, with durable receipts and duplicate guards.
features.gap: Specialist provider/agent routing and broader private reference behavior remain unverified.
acceptance: A run reaches a persisted terminal state visible in the library without opening its detail.
Findings distinguish source facts, inference and limitations; failed runs remain actionable.

features.current: Public web research only; no dedicated social dataset or sentiment measurement pipeline.
features.gap: Authorized social search, posts/comments, timestamps, coverage and auditable sentiment analysis.
dependencies: Social data provider access and applicable usage rights.
acceptance: Results include actual retrievable posts, platform and observation dates with coverage limits.
Sentiment metrics disclose the source sample, denominator, method and uncertainty; unsupported coverage returns an explicit unavailable state.

features.current: No connected ad-library provider or creative search.
features.gap: Searchable competitor ads, creative evidence, advertiser and platform filtering.
dependencies: Authorized ad-library or licensed provider access.
acceptance: Search returns verifiable ad identifiers, creatives, advertisers, source links and observation dates.
Ad volume is not labeled as spend, conversions or performance; unavailable metrics remain unavailable.

features.current: Audience and trends templates synthesize open-web evidence. Persona snapshots offer explicitly labeled hypothetical perspectives.
features.gap: Measured trend signals and licensed representative audience panels.
dependencies: Trend data access; separate audience dataset license if representative measurement is offered.
acceptance: Trend claims include observed period, geography and the actual underlying metric.
Panel outputs expose methodology and source; simulated persona responses are clearly separated from measured audience evidence.

features.current: Dedicated Pitch workspace saves structured RFP/client intake and agency credential snapshots, references owned context files, creates an editable manual playbook, launches cited research through the existing one-step background workflow engine, explicitly imports completed research, retains append-only playbook/source revisions with conflict checks and restore, and exports saved Markdown. Intake records, agency profiles and pitches support private ownership; agency profiles and pitches can be archived/restored. Each research run consumes the existing report allowance. Saved pitch playbooks export editable DOCX with saved revision, intake, supplied agency snapshot, body, clickable source links and limitations; unsaved edits disable export. Revision-specific internal comments and owner approvals/change requests, complete intake/agency snapshots on new revisions, optional full restore, older revision pagination and editable PowerPoint export are implemented.
features.gap: Legacy revisions cannot reconstruct missing intake snapshots. External client portals, per-record access and automatic communications are not enabled. Specialist evidence requires providers.
acceptance: A real brief plus agency credentials produces traceable requirements, uncertainties, distinct angles and sourced proof points.
Users can revise and retain a playbook, follow up, and export/share it without losing evidence.

features.current: Active hourly Google Cloud Scheduler in local-snow-508108-g3 calls the authenticated OIDC monitoring dispatcher. Daily/weekly/monthly rules, duplicate guards, retries and saved report history exist. A real Google-triggered QA report completed with four citations and one report after duplicate dispatch. QA rules are paused; all saved brands are configured for weekly India briefings, with no real business brands yet saved. Owner-scoped scan history paginates beyond 100 reports. New scans snapshot the earlier completed same-rule report at launch; comparable scopes receive a cited changes section within the existing provider call. Report detail compares normalized source URLs, links the earlier briefing and exports the comparison with the current report and citations. First/legacy/unfinished/changed-scope states are explicit; private baseline metadata is omitted from shared reports. Opt-in verified-account Gmail notifications now use a durable outbox on the hourly dispatcher, including completion, partial results, failures and prelaunch refusals. Test email, health checks, receipts, rejection retries and duplicate-risk manual recovery are visible in Monitoring. Local-time IANA schedules support cadence/day/time, DST gaps/repeats and month-end clamping. CAS/lease guards preserve execution and pause/history; the hourly dispatcher remains unchanged.
features.gap: Gmail OAuth remains Testing. Exact-minute delivery, team email fan-out and specialist datasets remain unavailable.
dependencies: Verified scheduler, monitored execution, delivery mechanism and appropriate connected datasets.
acceptance: Daily/weekly/monthly runs execute without an open browser, with retry and duplicate prevention.
Month-end and timezone behavior is defined and tested; delivered alerts point to saved reports with comparable periods and explicit data limits.
knownIssues: General saved timezone preference is not applied to rule scheduling; the deployed dispatcher uses Asia/Calcutta and cadence instants are UTC-based. Monthly month-end clamping is tested.

features.current: Read-only owner-scoped API keys and MCP list_reports, get_report, list_profiles. Keys now have report/profile permissions, expiry, atomic60/min request budgets and24h counters. REST report-library and MCP search_reports expose full metadata pagination; legacy lists remain unchanged.
features.gap: Licensed raw/aggregate/analysis feeds remain unavailable. Team keys are disabled. Revoke new scoped keys before any rollback to older authorization code.
dependencies: Licensed data access, endpoint contracts, quotas and provider cost controls.
acceptance: Documented API/MCP requests return real connected data with provenance and bounded costs.
Key scopes, revocation, tenant isolation, rate limits and usage accounting are verified.

features.current: Google/email-password authentication, owner-isolated records and account/usage controls. Approved INR/USD Solo and Pro plans have Razorpay checkout, verification, webhooks, cancellation and usage code, but test/live payment configuration is deliberately disabled because keys were deferred. No team membership model. Separate team namespaces implement approved Owner/Editor/Viewer roles, hashed seven-day email-bound private invite links, immediate subsequent-request revocation, My/All team chat and active-session/device revocation. Reissue/removal invalidate outstanding invite links.
features.gap: Team paid-plan sharing, notification delivery, ownership transfer, team deletion/retention administration and per-record privacy remain unavailable. Razorpay activation/testing and Gmail production authorization remain pending.
dependencies: Confirmed SignalForge commercial terms, payment provider and transactional delivery.
acceptance: Invited members receive only their permitted workspace access; removing access invalidates subsequent reads and writes.
If payments are enabled, verified payment events update entitlements idempotently and cancellation/refund behavior follows the agreed terms.

deliveryOrder: Brand context, conversations, projects, workflows, files and report organization using the current theme.
Real provider-backed social, ads, trends and audience capabilities with observable failures and coverage disclosures.
Complete Pitch intake/playbooks and activate reliable monitoring with historical comparison and delivery.
Expand developer APIs, teams and commercial operations once access and terms are established.

verification.releaseScope: Provider-free team collaboration, brand/pitch history, Office text ingestion, PowerPoint exports, voice input, local-time monitoring, sessions and scoped developer access. Full Waldo parity remains incomplete.
evidence: Real saved chat with contextual follow-up and a three-step background workflow were verified in the preceding releases.
Google Cloud Scheduler executed a real monitoring scan with cited saved output; duplicate dispatch produced one report.
Worker API tests exercise actual PDF/DOCX parsers, exact original downloads, file context in provider requests, invalid/scanned inputs, archive/restore and cross-owner isolation.

Worker integration tests verify pitch snapshots, concurrent revision conflicts, restore, owner isolation, duplicate launch suppression, real file context in requests, explicit imports and quota enforcement.

98 fixture/policy tests pass, including monitor ownership, baseline selection, scope changes, duplicate dispatch, pagination and shared-report isolation. Two real isolated provider scans completed with six and four cited sources; the second retained the first baseline and generated a comparison section.

104 fixture/policy tests pass; six added Worker integration tests cover an older report beyond 100, combined/literal filters, tied-date pagination/new inserts, input validation, favorites/owner isolation and developer-key compatibility. Isolated actual Workspace browser QA reaches all 132 fictional reports, recovers after a simulated page failure, and preserves filters/view after report navigation and reload.

110 fixture/policy tests pass. New checks cover concurrent brand CAS edits, ownership and read-only API boundaries, old/new chat context snapshots, unchanged report/workflow inputs, automatic-rule pause/schedule preservation, atomic rollback, all-report counts beyond 100, active/archived files and additive schema compatibility. Actual Workspace browser QA exercises stale-edit rejection with draft retention, reload locking, revised research prefill and brand-linked report/files/workflow/chat navigation.

Six Word export checks validate all OOXML package members and relationship targets, citations, unsafe links/XML, Unicode, tables/lists/code, partial-state disclosures, saved pitch revision/intake/agency/body and excluded private fields. Export uses the existing browser data without provider calls or a new server endpoint.
Provider-free release acceptance and QA/runtime limits: docs/provider-free-release-acceptance.json.
limits: Provider-dependent social/ad/audience datasets are not connected.
Waldo private workflow execution and team permission behavior are not an exhaustive tested specification.
Build/test and live Files publication evidence are recorded separately in the release acceptance record.
